headword: {着信|ちゃくしん}{履歴|りれき}

definitions.gloss: call history; incoming call log; received call record
definitions.explanation: A record of incoming phone calls on a mobile phone or other device. A common feature on smartphones.

examples.japanese: {着信|ちゃくしん}{履歴|りれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{着信|ちゃくしん}{履歴|りれき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}っていた→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: An unknown number was left in my call history.

examples.japanese: {着信|ちゃくしん}{履歴|りれき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{折|お}り{返|かえ}し→折り返す：21024_orikaesu⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: I called the person back from my call history.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{着信|ちゃくしん}→着信：07685_chakushin⟧ (incoming call/message) + ⟦{履歴|りれき}→履歴：09334_rireki⟧ (history/log). Used in everyday phone-related contexts for the record of received calls on a mobile phone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {着信|ちゃくしん}{履歴|りれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check the call history
- {着信|ちゃくしん}{履歴|りれき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: to appear in call history
- {着信|ちゃくしん}{履歴|りれき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{折|お}り{返|かえ}す→折り返す：21024_orikaesu⟧: to call back from the call history
- {着信|ちゃくしん}{履歴|りれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削除|さくじょ}→削除：04171_sakujo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to delete call history

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{発信|はっしん}{履歴|りれき}→発信履歴：24682_hasshinrireki⟧: outgoing call log
- ⟦{不在|ふざい}{着信|ちゃくしん}→不在着信：08041_fuzaichakushin⟧: missed call
- ⟦{通話|つうわ}→通話：14369_tsuuwa⟧⟦{履歴|りれき}→履歴：09334_rireki⟧: call log (both incoming and outgoing)
- ⟦{着信|ちゃくしん}{音|おん}→着信音：08040_chakushinon⟧: ringtone

In casual speech, people often shorten to {着歴|ちゃくれき}.
